name: TOPMIX
recent: TOPMIX 近期以 RM16 million 收购 Subang Jaya 一幅永久地契土地，用于办公室及仓储用途；同时已完成 Senai 厂房及土地以 RM1.85 million 出售的交易。公司也宣派每股 0.60 sen 的单层中期股息。
notable: 以 RM16 million 收购 Subang Jaya 一幅永久地契土地，用作办公室及仓储。
以 RM1.85 million 完成出售 Senai 一幅土地及 1 1/2 层半独立式工厂。
宣派截至 2026 年 12 月 31 日财政年度每股 0.60 sen 的单层中期股息。
risks: Senai 物业出售的余款曾延迟支付，完成日期已延长至 2026 年第四季度。
独立非执行主席 Chang Tian Kwang 在闭市期外增持 116,100 股普通股。

news.title: Topmix to buy Subang Jaya land for RM16m for office, warehousing use
Topmix unit acquires new office, warehousing premises for RM16mil
Topmix to buy Subang Jaya land for RM16 mil for office, warehouse use
Topmix to buy Subang Jaya land for RM16m for offices and warehousing
Topmix extends RM1.85m Senai property disposal to 4Q2026

recent_en: TOPMIX recently acquired a piece of freehold land in Subang Jaya for RM16 million for office and warehousing use, and completed the disposal of its Senai factory and land for RM1.85 million. The company also declared a single-tier interim dividend of 0.60 sen per share.
notable_en: Acquired a piece of freehold land in Subang Jaya for RM16 million for office and warehousing use.
Completed the disposal of a piece of land and a 1 1/2 storey semi-detached factory in Senai for RM1.85 million.
Declared a single-tier interim dividend of 0.60 sen per share for the financial year ending 31 December 2026.
risks_en: The balance sale consideration for the Senai property disposal was previously outstanding, and the completion date was extended to the fourth quarter of 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Chang Tian Kwang acquired 116,100 ordinary shares outside the closed period.
